generations.name: First generation
generations.notes: Launch on GM Ultium (800 V, DC up to 350 kW). Packs: Standard Range (~119 kWh), Extended Range (~170 kWh), Max Range (~205 kWh). 2026 drops the RST and adds the Trail Boss with the same pack tiers. No line-wide pack or DC change found, so one generation. The pack kWh figures come from Wikipedia and are not tied to model years or trims there; the 2026 Max Range range figures (478 vs 493 mi) differ between sources. GM says 2027 GM EVs get native NACS (port change only). Confidence: medium (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chevrolet_Silverado_EV ; https://www.cars.com/articles/2026-chevrolet-silverado-ev-adds-trail-boss-off-road-trim-subtracts-rst-510152
